summary: No plan modifications were required because all findings were either previously addressed in Task 1 and Task 2 of plan.md and task-manifest.json or successfully rebutted. The DTO narrowing and application mapper updates are already performed atomically in Task 1, all three declared behavioral invariants are fully covered with explicit test cases in Task 2, and FakeRegimePlanPort.ts uses a HOLD action without exitIntent, requiring no edits to maintain clean typechecking.
rebuttal:
Finding 1: Addressed in existing plan. Task 1 already includes the atomic update of packages/application/src/dto/regimePlan.ts and packages/application/src/use-cases/plans/RequestPositionPlan.ts alongside the JSON schema change.
Finding 2: Addressed in existing plan. Task 2 already contains explicit steps (Steps 2, 3, and 4) and test implementations covering all three declared invariants.
Finding 3: Rebutted. packages/testing/src/fakes/FakeRegimePlanPort.ts uses an action of type HOLD ({ type: 'HOLD', reasonCode: 'FAKE' }), which does not include exitIntent, and compiles cleanly without modification when RegimePlanAction is narrowed.
